note: Album allow-lists, for artists where an automatic discography is the wrong answer. Anything listed here that is missing from the fetched data is pulled in by scripts/curate-artist.js, including release groups MusicBrainz classifies as soundtracks. Artists absent from this file keep whatever the fetch returned.

the-beatles.reason: The thirteen core studio albums. MusicBrainz also carries the US Capitol variants — Meet The Beatles!, Something New, Beatles VI and the rest — which repackage the same recordings and would list every song several times over. A Hard Day's Night, Help!, Magical Mystery Tour and Yellow Submarine are filed as soundtracks and have to be named to survive the studio-album filter.
